I taught myself some basic HTML and CSS this year to work on a website to display my writing. I'd like to be able to have buttons that filter by genre. I think I need Javascript? Something I have no experience in. I'd like to have a way to select multiple things, so if someone really wanted to see all of my Poems that were Horror they'd only see horror poems. Is there an easy way to tell the code I assign genre and format classes to the various storyblock divs that hold the links to the story pages, and filter by those classes?
